Period ending 31st March 2026

The FMCG segment, comprising Magic, Kotmale, KIST, Ride, Knuckles Water, Goldi and Sara's, delivered another strong quarter,
                                                                                                                                        value for all stakeholders while strengthening the Group's position in an increasingly competitive marketplace.
recording revenue growth of 20.3% year-on-year, driven primarily by volume expansion. Growth was broad-based, with all key
categories reporting strong volume gains, except for confectionery, which experienced a softer performance during the period.
Selective price revisions were implemented across certain product categories to partially offset increases in raw material and
other input costs. Operating expenses also rose during the quarter, reflecting higher energy and fuel costs. Despite these
challenges, operating profit increased by 24.3%, while margins improved, supported by strong volume growth, favourable
product mix, and ongoing cost optimisation initiatives.
Performance was underpinned by growth across all major channels, including general trade, modern trade and food service.
While the segment remains well positioned for growth, continued volatility in global commodity markets and supply chain
disruptions may exert pressure on input costs and margins in the months ahead.

3. Contingent liabilities

   The income tax concession claimed under the Inland Revenue Act, No. 10 of 2006 and Act, No. 24 of 2017, as well as the Value Added Tax
   concession/exemption claimed under the Value Added Tax Act, No 14 of 2002 have been contested by the Department of Inland Revenue.
   The contingent liabilities for the Group in respect of these amount to Rs 871 Mn and Rs 5,251 Mn respectively.

   Having sought professional advice, the Management is confident that the tax concessions are applicable and as such no liabilities would
   arise. Accordingly, no provision has been made in the financial statements.
